title: Seiton Popular Actions Targets
description: Repository-managed target set for popular actions updater. Download URLs are in data/sources/manifest.json (dataset popular-actions), in the same order as targets sorted by uses.

actionRef.description: Display/reference value. If omitted, updater treats it as same as uses.

uses.description: Canonical uses key, for example actions/checkout

rawFileName.description: Local raw artifact file name only

maxDeprecatedMajorVersion.description: Maximum major version that uses a deprecated runner (e.g. 3 means v3 and below use node16). 0 or omitted means no known deprecated versions.
